definitions: def FutureUnit (v : FourVector) : Prop := lorentzNormSq v = -1 ∧ 0 < v 0
exact_target_signatures: theorem boostedB_futureUnit_iff (epsilon chi b2 b3 : Real) (he : 0 < epsilon) (h2 : 0 < b2) (h3 : 0 < b3) (v : FourVector) : ((boostedB epsilon chi b2 b3).mulVec v = 0 ∧ FutureUnit v) ↔ v = uChi chi
accepted_lemma_signatures: G03BBoostedKernelMembership.boostedB_mulVec_uChi_zero (epsilon chi b2 b3 : Real) : (boostedB epsilon chi b2 b3).mulVec (uChi chi) = 0

G03BBoostedKernelSpan.boostedB_mulVec_eq_zero_iff (epsilon chi b2 b3 : Real) (he : 0 < epsilon) (h2 : 0 < b2) (h3 : 0 < b3) (v : FourVector) : (boostedB epsilon chi b2 b3).mulVec v = 0 ↔ ∃ t : Real, v = t • uChi chi
